statement: The Epoch Capabilities Index gain in 2027 is < 50% of its 2025 gain (Epoch AI; 2028-01)
status_at_phase_end: Data gap: the composite capabilities index named in the indicator did not exist in 2023 (first published October 2025), and neither reference year had occurred.

items.summary: No composite cross-benchmark capabilities index existed during the phase; the index the indicator relies on was first published in late 2025, so no in-phase value or gain can be recorded.
items.detail: Epoch AI, 'Epoch Capabilities Index' page (opened via web_extract this run): its own citation metadata gives year 2025, month 10 as the publication date. Any ECI values for 2023-era models are retrospective (published after the phase) and excluded under the as-of rule.
